oncall-ryan: acked. I'm looking now.

oncall-ryan: quick triage: traffic % to economy variants: 67% (target should be 10% for canary). Latency fine, but quality breach. Suspect policy mis-evaluation favored cheapest variant due to a new cost-slope change.

infra-nik: pulling policy config now.


infra-nik: found the policy change: operator edited cost weights at 1721234300, lowering cost_penalty by 0.6. Policy YAML excerpt: 
```
policy_id: policy-eco-34
rules:
  - condition: budget_tier == "low"
    weights:
      cost: 0.85
      quality: 0.15
    fallback: cheapest_variant
```

oncall-ryan: that explains it. Somebody bumped cost weight high, quality weight too low. Need live mitigation.

prod-maria: impact matrix: 5 enterprise customers with heavy sessions (avg qps 50) likely exposed. Potential SLA/contract hits if not fixed in 30m. Customer Ops is on standby.

oncall-ryan: mitigation plan (short):
- disable policy-eco-34 globally for gen-api-prod and force default routing
- pin critical customers to stable-variant v1 for 60m
- roll back cost-weight change in policy manager
- run quick A/B eval on 200 sampled requests

oncall-ryan: executing disable now:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://controlplane.redwood.internal/policies/policy-eco-34/actions/disable
```

incidents-bot: Action recorded: policy-eco-34 disabled by oncall-ryan at 1721234612

oncall-ryan: confirm: routing proportion to economy variants dropped to 9% in eu-west-1. Quality metrics starting to stabilize.

ml-kash: running quick eval: A/B sample of 200 requests against stable variant -> accuracy 90/200 vs 64/200 for eco variant. Sending eval summary to thread.

data-sam: hooking up traces to see whether cached KV prefixes caused more misroutes. No sign of cache bleed.

customer-josh: customer ops update: notified 3 customers about degraded experience and that we are rolling back routing; two replied they saw improvements after ~3m.

infra-nik: rolling back policy change in source-of-truth now. Patch applied:
```
- cost: 0.85
- quality: 0.15
+ cost: 0.35
+ quality: 0.65
```

oncall-ryan: leaving a manual override for service=gen-api-prod region=eu-west-1 for 30m to prevent auto-re-enable: `route.override(policy-eco-34)=disabled_until:1721236567`

oncall-lee: taking handoff for the next shift. I'll monitor for next 2 hours and coordinate with SRE/ML if any slow regressions.
